en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, rectangular post office building on a broad, mostly empty square. The three‑story structure has a tiled gabled roof, many evenly spaced windows, and an entrance marked with the word "POSTAMT" above the doorway. Several early automobiles and bicycles stand in front of the building. Bare trees frame the image, suggesting late autumn or winter. On the right margin of the card there is handwritten script indicating the place and building.
